data_objects.name: geographic_housing_areas
data_objects.meaning: Geographically located area-level housing and population summaries, with average household attributes and a median house-value measure.
data_objects.notes: No explicit area identifier or geographic aggregation level is provided.

variables.name: MedInc
variables.meaning: Median income measure for the geographic area, stored in an undocumented scale.

variables.name: AveRooms
variables.meaning: Average number of rooms per household in the area.

variables.name: AveBedrms
variables.meaning: Average number of bedrooms per household in the area.

variables.name: Population
variables.meaning: Population represented by the area record.

variables.name: AveOccup
variables.meaning: Average household occupancy for the area.

variables.name: Longitude
variables.meaning: Longitude coordinate locating the area, with west longitudes represented as negative values.

variables.name: MedianHouseValue
variables.meaning: Median house-value measure for the area in an undocumented monetary scale.

structure.description: Each row is an aggregate for one geographic housing area rather than an individual dwelling or person.
Latitude and Longitude jointly locate an area, but the table does not establish them as a unique key; physical row order has no documented semantic role.

uncertainties: The monetary units and scaling of MedInc and MedianHouseValue are not stated.
The precise geographic unit and source population underlying each row are not identified by the CSV.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
